sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which part of your body is most important for kicking a football effectively?
options: C) Inside or instep of the foot
questions.answer: C) Inside or instep of the foot

questions.question_text: In the traditional game of 'Pitthou' (Lagori), what objects are stacked on top of each other?
What is the primary purpose of a 'warm-up' before playing games?
options: A) To make you feel tired before the game starts
B) To prepare the muscles and prevent injuries
D) To take a water break
questions.answer: B) To prepare the muscles and prevent injuries

questions.question_text: Which yoga asana is also known as the 'Tree Pose'?

options: A) Jumping on one foot repeatedly
C) Moving forward with one foot always leading the other
questions.answer: C) Moving forward with one foot always leading the other

questions.question_text: When you are trying to catch a ball thrown high in the air, where should your eyes be looking?
options: A) At the ground to avoid tripping
B) At the person who threw it
C) Continuously tracking the ball in the air
questions.answer: C) Continuously tracking the ball in the air

questions.question_text: Which of these is a good example of 'Sportsmanship'?
options: A) Shouting at a teammate who makes a mistake
B) Shaking hands with the opposing team after the game
C) Refusing to play if you are losing
questions.answer: B) Shaking hands with the opposing team after the game

questions.question_text: In the game of Kabaddi, what must the 'raider' do continuously while in the opponent's half?
options: A) Hold their breath and stay completely silent
C) Chant the word 'Kabaddi' without breaking breath
questions.answer: C) Chant the word 'Kabaddi' without breaking breath

questions.question_text: Why is it important to stay hydrated (drink water) during physical education classes?
options: A) It makes you run faster
B) It replaces the water your body loses through sweat
C) It makes the ball softer to hit
D) It helps you balance on one leg
questions.answer: B) It replaces the water your body loses through sweat

questions.question_text: If you are holding a bat to strike a ball, which hand should usually be placed higher up on the handle (for a right-handed player)?
options: C) Both hands at exactly the same level

questions.question_text: Describe the correct position of your hands when catching a ball thrown low towards your waist or legs.
questions.answer: When catching a low ball, the fingers should point downwards toward the ground, with the pinky fingers touching together to create a basket shape.

questions.question_text: Name two basic locomotor movements (movements that travel from one place to another).
questions.answer: Two basic locomotor movements are skipping and running (or hopping, galloping).

questions.question_text: What is the main goal of the traditional game 'Kho-Kho'?
questions.answer: The main goal in Kho-Kho is for the 'chasers' to tag all the 'defenders' of the opposing team in the shortest amount of time possible by passing the turn to sitting teammates.

questions.question_text: Why should we practice simple deep breathing exercises (Yoga Sadhana) after a very active physical game?
questions.answer: Deep breathing helps to calm the mind, slow down a fast heart rate, and bring the body back to a relaxed, balanced state after intense activity.

questions.question_text: What is a 'foul' in a sports game? Give one simple example.
questions.answer: A foul is an action that breaks the rules of the game. An example is pushing another player intentionally to get the ball.

sections.section_name: Section C - Sports Mechanics & Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Fill in the blanks with the correct physical terms (Stretch, Swing, Target): 1. When you strike a ball with a bat, the movement of your arms is called a ________. 2. Before running, we must ________ our leg muscles. 3. In games like archery or throwing games, the object you aim at is called the ________.
Match the Yoga posture/Asana to its correct description: 1. Tadasana -> _____ 2. Vrikshasana -> _____ (Choose from: Standing tall and straight like a palm tree, Balancing on one leg like a tree)
questions.answer: 1. Standing tall and straight like a palm tree, 2. Balancing on one leg like a tree

questions.question_text: During a football match at recess, your team scores a goal, but you noticed that the ball accidentally touched your hand just before it went in. The referee (your teacher) did not see it. What is the correct and honest thing to do in this situation?
questions.answer: The correct and honest thing to do is to go to the teacher/referee and admit that the ball touched your hand. Even if it means the goal is canceled, showing true sportsmanship and honesty is more important than winning by breaking the rules.

questions.question_text: Your younger brother wants to learn how to throw a ball properly. Design a simple 3-step practice plan to teach him how to throw overhand safely and accurately.
questions.answer: Step 1: Stance - Tell him to stand sideways to the target, with his non-throwing shoulder pointing toward where he wants the ball to go. Step 2: The 'L' Shape - Have him lift the ball up near his ear, making his throwing arm look like the letter 'L'. Step 3: Step and Throw - Instruct him to step forward with his opposite foot while bringing his arm forward to release the ball at the target.
